children: Kuwait-based Heavy Engineering Industries and Ship-building Company (Heisco) announced on Tuesday the signing of a contract for harbour and marina construction works with a total value of 5.7 million Kuwaiti dinars ($18 million).
Its subsidiary Gulf Dredging &General Contracting Company inked the deal for Sharq Waterfront Development project in Kuwait, Heisco said in a bourse statement.

The project involves "the design, permitting, construction, testing and commissioning, and handover of the harbour and marine works for Sharq Waterfront Development Project -Third Stage", the statement said, adding that revenue will be shown in annual financial statements from 2026 to 2027.
(Writing by N Saeed; Editing by Anoop Menon)
